p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: the official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change frequently: ONE WORLD does not copy them, but opens the current official sources, then you read them in your language.

p.espaces.rg_g2: The Market Access Card (MAC): duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: Standards, labelling and health rules that this country sets for products

p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: customs code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Ready for Business (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, by country

p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between the parties.24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): obligations and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access to markets (European Union): customs duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs Code (HS Code) and Duties on Entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: bill of lading (sea freight), air waybill (air freight), road freight)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: Number (enterprises importing or exporting within the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: The buyer deals with everything from the seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: The seller delivers the goods to the buyer’s carrier, who ships them to their destination.
p.espaces.cu_i3: The seller loads the goods on the ship; the risks and costs are then borne by the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: The seller pays the costs of transport and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: The seller delivers to the destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: The seller pays everything, including import duties.

p.espaces.mt_d: Compare the fees for your country before sending money.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD itself does not send money and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then send with the service you have chosen.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Worldwide money transfer costs (World Bank): the real costs of sending money, by country, by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet

p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount you get: fee + exchange rate – worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how to receive it: in cash, to a bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID is often required, both for sending and receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you’ve only met online or to “unlock” a prize, shipment, loan or visa: this is almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer. It is easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorized in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (Wholesale / Supplier "listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real cost: product, shipping, customs, VAT on the customer's side, payment and return fees.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the real delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trading rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for consumers' rights: clear prices, including taxes, right of return, guarantee, protection of personal data.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A vendor who asks for full payment via unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich fast.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a shipment from a non-EU country pays VAT from the first euro.
